learning_outcomes.text: Recognize and understand the institutional and legal framework applicable to the business environment.
Recognize and understand the organizational and management systems applicable to the company.
Act effectively in a multilingual and multidisciplinary team.
Propose creative solutions to satisfactorily respond to real needs and problems of society.
Develop professional texts and scientific-technical reports according to the conventions of the industrial engineering field.
Adapt content organization and the use of verbal and non-verbal language to argue in various situations or before various audiences.
Develop the planning of activities, people, and resources in companies, organizations, and institutions.
Appropriately organize activities, people, and resources in companies, organizations, and institutions.
Apply industrial engineering knowledge to the learning of new methods and theories.
Critically and constructively show the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem.

syllabus_topics: Block I: FUNDAMENTALS ABOUT THE COMPANY

Topic 1. THE COMPANY AND THE ENTREPRENEUR: Concept of company, elements and functions. The figure of the entrepreneur. Types of companies. The business environment. Theories about the company. The company as a system.

Topic 2. COMPANY OBJECTIVES: Classical conception of company objectives. Management and objectives. Organization Theory. Value creation as an objective. Social responsibility, ethics, and company reputation.
Topic 3. COMPANY DEVELOPMENT AND GROWTH: Company location and size decisions. The business development process and its modalities. The internationalization process.
Topic 1. MANAGEMENT: The business management process. Decisions and their types. Decision-making processes. Management levels. Management roles.
Topic 2. PRODUCTION SYSTEM: The production function. Types of production systems. Production planning tools. Efficiency control.
Topic 3. COMMERCIAL SYSTEM: Marketing activity. Product, distribution, price, and communication strategies.
Topic 4. FINANCIAL SYSTEM: The financial function. The company's financial environment. The financing function. The investment function.
teaching_methods: Mixed tests (written exams on theoretical and practical content)
Case study (analysis and discussion of a case)
Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom (formulation, analysis, resolution, and debate)
Gamification (use of game elements to promote interest and active participation)
assessment_rules: Inappropriate behavior in the classroom will be negatively factored into the final grade. The use of mobile devices is prohibited unless required for an activity. The mere possession of electronic communication devices is expressly forbidden during evaluation tests. Any irregularities during evaluation will result in the application of relevant regulations. The grading systems may be subject to modifications or exceptional situations.
